findings.title: HMI Start/Stop/Reset and drive-overload fault display matched independent PLC outputs
findings.inference: After the declared overload injection, PLC independently reported Faulted/Drive overload with motor command off and red stack light on, and HMI pixels showed the same fault/mode on Operation. After clearing the overload and HMI Reset, PLC reported Stopped, fault 0, motor off, no active item and no pending completion, consistent with Reset not restarting the belt.
assumptions: Injected truth ref 2612 is kept separate from PLC-output claims.
No carton sorting was in scope for this UI checkpoint.
findings.uncertainty: UI-04 stale/unknown/WCS-disconnect behavior was not induced and remains inconclusive; divert-motion feedback congruence was not exercised with a carton.

finalization.summary: UI checkpoint completed via actual HMI clicks on controlled browser. UI-01 pass: START/STOP/RESET/AUTO labels with Applied-by-PLC or Readback-confirmed visible results corroborated by PLC acks. UI-02 pass: HMI separately displayed motor/divert command vs observed feedback, including commanded-no-feedback and off-while-running states. UI-03 pass: injected drive overload showed Faulted mode and 'Drive overload' fault text on Operation, matching PLC FaultCode 10/FaultText. UI-04 inconclusive: only Fresh data observed, no stale/unknown or WCS disconnect was induced. Reset after clearing overload returned PLC to Stopped, FaultCode 0, Motor_RunCmd false, ItemActive false, CompletionPending false; Auto turned off. Finding FIND-HMI-01 records exact PLC claims with injected truth kept separate.

data.observation: Pixels show stable START, STOP, RESET and AUTO ON/OFF labels. Start frame shows AUTO and 'Applied by PLC'; Stop frame shows STOPPING and 'Applied by PLC'; Reset frame shows STOPPED with Reset 'Applied by PLC' and ResetAck 1 in control header; Auto frames show distinct ON/OFF selected states and 'Readback confirmed'. Independent PLC outputs show StartAck/StopAck then ResetAck=1.
data.uncertainty: Auto has readback only, no PLC Auto acknowledgement field as stated on HMI; that limitation was visible and not treated as a mode acknowledgement.

data.observation: Operation view has separate COMMAND and FEEDBACK (OBSERVED) columns. Start-result pixels show M1 RUN commanded while feedback is STOPPED with text 'Commanded; no running feedback yet'. Stop-result pixels show M1 OFF while feedback is RUNNING with text 'Not commanded; feedback still running (coast/stop)'. Diverts show RETRACT command separately from HOME/EXTENDED feedback. This distinguishes command from feedback rather than painting running solely from command.
data.uncertainty: Assessment is for the displayed command-versus-feedback distinction in the captured Start/Stop transitions; no carton/divert motion sequence was in scope.

data.observation: On the main Operation view without navigation, pixels show top banner 'PLC MODE Faulted', 'ALARMS 1 active - F10 Drive overload', red banner 'FAULT 10 Drive overload - Drive overload input is on. Faulted, motor off', Alarms tab badge 1, and CONTROLS heading FAULTED. Independent PLC output at 2745 is ModeText Faulted, FaultCode 10, FaultText Drive overload.
data.uncertainty: Only the injected drive-overload fault text was tested; other fault texts were not exercised.

data.observation: Healthy/fault frames show 'PLC DATA Fresh' with an age and a RELEASE-WCS panel, but no stale-data condition, unknown-quality condition, or WCS disconnect was induced or observed. Therefore stale/unknown and WCS-disconnect display behavior was not tested.
data.uncertainty: No stale/disconnect stimulus was performed in this UI checkpoint; a healthy Fresh indication cannot prove stale or disconnect handling.
